rec.name: PDP Product Thumbnails Gallery (Theme-Agnostic Slider)
rec.status: Built — launched (source code + setup guide delivered; documented)

what.text: A standalone, theme-agnostic product media section. A main image slider is paired with a clickable thumbnail strip, placed left of or below the main image on desktop. On mobile the thumbnails can be shown below or swapped for pagination dots. The section also supports video slides with a round video thumbnail button (play icon) that opens a fullscreen video popup, optional video autoplay and looping, and automatic selection of the active slide when a product variant is chosen. The original request was to recreate the Focal theme's thumbnail function 1:1 as its own section so it can be used in other themes.

why.text: Thumbnails show shoppers up front how many images exist and what they show (angles, details, in-use shots, infographics, video). That lowers the effort of exploring the product, supports purchase confidence, and increases media engagement. Syncing the slider to the selected variant shows the exact colour or version the shopper picked, which reduces uncertainty and returns. The video bubble draws attention to rich content.

how.text: 1) Create the snippet ed-product-media.liquid and paste in the delivered CSS and Liquid. 2) The section uses two Flickity carousels: carousel-nav (thumbnails) and carousel-main (large images), loops over product.media, and renders image, video, or 3D-model badges. 3) Layout is controlled by CSS classes: ed-thumbnails-left, ed-thumbnails-right, ed-thumbnails-bottom, and ed-thumbnails-bottom-mobile. 4) On mobile without thumbnails, pagination dots are shown (a long active dot, short inactive ones) plus small arrows. 5) Desktop prev/next uses half-width clickable zones with custom arrow cursors. 6) The video bubble is a circular thumbnail at the top right of the image that opens a fullscreen popup with a close button. 7) Variant sync: custom JavaScript reads the variant ID from the URL. If the variant has a featured image that exists in the slider, that slide is set as active. This works because every theme updates the URL with the variant ID. 8) Setup guide and source ZIP were provided to developers.

items: Desktop thumbnails position (Left / Bottom; code also supports Right)
Optional transparent gradient arrows on the thumbnail strip

dependencies.text: Flickity carousel library. Theme-specific icon snippets (e.g. render 'icon' for video/3D badges) and the theme's media setup. The variant-to-slide sync depends on the variant ID being written to the URL. Product media must be in product.media. The existing CSS references hnds.de arrow assets, which should be replaced per store. Reference screenshots come from Solago (hnds.de) and the Focal theme. Rana also built a product video play button in a separate ticket.

items: Thumbnail click rate / image interactions per session

images.caption: Final result: vertical thumbnail strip on the left of the main image with an active-thumbnail border and a round video bubble at the top right.
Theme editor: Media settings (video autoplay, looping, show thumbnails on mobile, desktop thumbnails position Left/Bottom) with the thumbnail strip highlighted.
Reference (Solago): thumbnail strip below the main image, with a progress bar over the active thumbnail and rounded thumbnails.
Mobile: pagination dots and arrows instead of thumbnails, with a video bubble at the top right.
